security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, setup paths, URLs, and license text. Manual review found no prompt injection attempt, hidden file access, or executable code inside the skill files. The main residual risk is intentional access to sensitive CRM, contact, calendar, and email data through Rarefriend MCP.

content.user_title: Manage Rarefriend CRM from AI agents
content.value_statement: Personal relationship data is scattered across contacts, calendars, email, and notes. This skill connects AI agents to Rarefriend workflows for search, scheduling, and relationship context.
actual_capabilities: Search Rarefriend contacts by name, company, role, email, source, or tag.
Create, update, tag, and delete CRM contacts and notes through MCP tools.
Find, create, reschedule, and cancel Google Calendar events.
Search Outlook contacts, calendar events, and emails when integrations are connected.
Start OAuth connection flows for Google, Microsoft, and Rarefriend integrations.
Provide setup guidance for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI.
limitations: Requires a Rarefriend account, MCP credentials, and connected integrations.
Cannot access synced data until the user grants OAuth and sync completes.
LinkedIn sync requires the Rarefriend Chrome extension or CSV import.
Should not modify contacts, events, or notes without clear user approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare investor outreach
use_cases.description: Find contacts by company or tag, review past notes, and identify warm introductions before outreach.

use_cases.title: Schedule relationship meetings
use_cases.description: Resolve attendee emails, check calendar availability, and create meetings after confirming the selected time.

use_cases.title: Maintain CRM context
use_cases.description: Update contacts, add meeting notes, tag accounts, and keep relationship history searchable.

prompt_templates.title: Find a contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Alice Chen in my Rarefriend contacts and summarize her company, role, source, and latest note.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for a meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare me for my next meeting with Jordan. Include recent notes, related emails, and any follow-up items.

prompt_templates.title: Schedule with context
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a 30 minute time next week with Maya, resolve her email from my contacts, and ask me before creating the event.

prompt_templates.title: Organize a network segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Search contacts at Acme, identify missing roles or recent notes, propose tags, and wait for approval before applying changes.

output_examples.input: Who do I know at Stripe?
output_examples.output: A concise list of matching contacts with company, role, source label, and a suggested next step.

output_examples.input: Schedule a 30 minute call with Maya next week.
output_examples.output: Available slots, the resolved attendee email, and a confirmation question before creating the event.

output_examples.input: Find recent Outlook emails from Jordan.
output_examples.output: Recent messages grouped by thread, with sender, date, subject, and relevant CRM context.

best_practices: Connect only the integrations needed for the current workflow.
Ask for confirmation before creating, updating, deleting, or bulk importing records.
Use source labels and recent notes when presenting contact results.
anti_patterns: Do not run setup commands with real credentials in shared terminals.
Do not bulk import or delete records without explicit user confirmation.
Do not expose full email bodies or large contact lists when a summary is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a Rarefriend account, the Rarefriend MCP server, and OAuth connections for each external service.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup instructions cover Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and compatible Agent Skills clients.

faq.question: Can it read my email?
faq.answer: It can search Outlook email only after the Microsoft email integration is connected through Rarefriend.

faq.question: Can it change my contacts or calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create, update, delete, reschedule, and cancel supported records through MCP tools.

faq.question: How is LinkedIn data synced?
faq.answer: LinkedIn sync uses the Rarefriend Chrome extension or CSV import, then stores searchable contacts in Rarefriend.

faq.question: Is setup automatic?
faq.answer: No. The user must configure the MCP server and approve each OAuth connection before data is available.
